thought: I need to create a story bible for SpaceGame, following the specific constraints provided.
title: The Broken Orbit
description: A pilot's desperate struggle to survive in the lawless fringes of the Aurelia sector.
campaign_pitch: You are an independent pilot struggling with debt. You must navigate trade routes and pirate threats to earn enough for a new ship.
campaign_story_summary: The Aurelia system is plagued by illegal smuggling. You start as a broke pilot in a scrapyard station. Kaelen offers you your first contract. A Reaver scout ship attacks during the delivery. You survive but realize the sector is unstable. Your survival depends on your ability to negotiate and fight.

factions.name: Zenith
factions.description: A high-tech corporation seeking order through strict regulation.

factions.name: Aurelia
factions.description: A loose confederation of miners and independent traders.

factions.name: Vanguard
factions.description: A militant group dedicated to purging pirate activity.

npcs.name: Kaelen
npcs.description: A fixer who handles contracts for the local trade routes.
npcs.notes: She knows more than she admits, but her true motives are hidden.

world_building: The system is a hub of illegal smuggling and desperate trade. The Reaver threat is constant but poorly understood.
gameplay_s_requirements: Mining, salvage, delivery, combat, station services, rumors, and gate exploration are all supported.
mission_1_description: Intercept a smuggler's cargo. A Reaver scout ship will intercept you during the flight.
mechanics_integration: The player must navigate gates, mine asteroids, and trade with various factions.
lore_thought: The local lore is centered on the immediate survival of independent pilots.
